newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Port conditions update-South Korea-Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update-South Korea-Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ULSAN - 110 Vessels in port (50 at berth, 60 at anchorage) usually 2-3 days delay due to berth congestion.
POHANG - 33 Vessels in port (33 berth, nil at anchorage) no delay.
INCHON - 74 Vessel in port (52 at berth, 22 at anchorage) usually 1-2 days delay due to berth congestion.
